lines.native: Buongiorno. Sono Marginalia. Qui ci sono molti libri. I sell only to people who understand what they read. Apparently, this is a niche market.
lines.translation: Good morning. I’m Marginalia. There are many books here. I sell only to people who understand what they read. Apparently, this is a niche market.
lines.narrative: A bookworm emerges from a chewed dictionary and annotates your arrival with a small question mark.
